title: エリザベス女王杯の後に・ツンツン女王

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet takes the victory and becomes the queen. She commands Vodka to be her maid for the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka objects, embarrassed, prompting Daiwa Scarlet to share her honest request.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She asks Vodka to stay her rival forever, staggering Vodka with the sudden sincerity.
